reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I told her I'm treating 8 April as an unconfirmed lead, not the actual Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date. I didn't update any records.

Before replying, I checked what Pree can see herself: the #central-team history and the public files. None of them mention Brackenwater, so there's nothing to confirm or contradict the 8 April date. I suggested she get the date confirmed in writing by the Brackenwater contact or the account owner before anyone plans around it.
